description.text: Soft, neutral daylight fills a simple interior space with a muted grey wall and a smooth floor.

stands facing forward at an easy, balanced stance, his dark blue jeans and mossy grey-green shirt reading clearly against the restrained background. The shirt's textured fabric sits naturally across his shoulders and chest, with gentle folds at the sleeves and hem, while his hands remain relaxed at his sides. His expression is calm and attentive, oriented toward the viewer. A subtle pool of light lifts the front of the shirt and separates him from the background, leaving soft shadow along one side of his face and body. The composition is open and uncluttered, keeping the wardrobe as the steady visual anchor as he begins a small, controlled shift of weight from one foot to the other.
Soft, even light falls across the neutral interior, and
stands in a steady forward-facing stance with the mossy grey-green shirt and dark blue jeans clearly visible.
shifts his weight subtly and keeps a calm gaze directed toward the viewer.
The camera holds a static shot.

continues from the same stance, his shoulders easing as he lifts one hand and draws it lightly across the front of the mossy grey-green shirt. The motion is unhurried and precise, letting the fabric ripple and then settle back into place without altering its color or fit. His dark blue jeans remain still and grounded below, while the light catches new ridges in the green cloth, revealing a slightly deeper mossy tone in the folds. His head turns a fraction, and his gaze stays steady and self-possessed. The surrounding interior stays quiet and minimal, with the grey wall and soft floor carrying the same diffuse illumination. The action emphasizes the shirt's material and the finished look rather than any further transformation, and his posture begins to loosen as the hand returns toward his side.
raises one hand and draws it slowly across the front of the mossy grey-green shirt.
The fabric catches the light in soft ridges, showing a deeper mossy tone while the dark blue jeans remain unchanged.
The camera pushes in with small amplitude at slow speed.

settles into a relaxed final stance, his weight evenly distributed and his arms hanging naturally beside the dark blue jeans. The mossy grey-green shirt hangs cleanly across his frame, with the collar and cuffs sitting neatly and the fabric responding to small, calm movements. His face holds a quiet, steady expression toward the viewer, and the soft light keeps the green tone consistent across the chest and sleeves. The neutral interior remains uncluttered, with a gentle shadow grounding him on the smooth floor and a pale gradient across the wall behind. The scene resolves on the completed wardrobe choice: the green shirt and blue jeans are clearly established, his posture is at ease, and the last moment holds a composed, still presence without introducing further changes.
lowers his hand and settles into a relaxed stance, letting the mossy grey-green shirt hang naturally.
A calm, steady expression and the clean line of the green shirt define the final held moment.
The camera holds a static shot.
